entries.en: The impatient moogle has had it up to here with the local wildlife.
entries.fr: Ce Mog scrute les environs d'un air fébrile.
entries.ja: 白亜の宮殿のきりきりモーグリは、周囲を警戒しているようだ。

entries.en: The impatient moogle is sick to his back teeth of the bladed vinegaroons, those spiny scalekin who terrorize travelers along the path through Ohl Tahn. He asks that you destroy four of their number to allow at least some passersby to escape unscathed.
entries.fr: Un Mog agité vous a demandé d'éliminer quatre des  qui rôdent dans les environs d'Ohl Tahn et qui le harcèlent.
entries.ja: きりきりモーグリの話を聞いた。がウロウロしていて怖いらしい。ドラヴァニア雲海のオール・ターンにいる「」を4体討伐しよう。

entries.en: You take down four of the bladed beasts. Return to Zenith, where the impatient moogle awaits word of your success with bated breath.
entries.fr: Vous avez appris les bonnes manières aux . Allez rapporter la bonne nouvelle au Mog agité.
entries.ja: を討伐した。白亜の宮殿の「きりきりモーグリ」に報告しよう。

entries.en: The moogle thanks you for your efforts, satisfied that the vinegaroons no longer pose an imminent threat. However, he cannot rest on his laurels just yet─so as long as the monsters continue to pursue any passing traveler, he must remain ever watchful.
entries.fr: Le Mog agité vous a remercié pour votre aide en espérant que les monstres qui le harcelaient aient retenu la leçon.
entries.ja: きりきりモーグリに報告した。見つかると追いかけられてしまうため、いつも警戒していたようだ。

entries.ja: きりきりモーグリに報告

entries.en: Have you seen those bladed vinegaroons loitering around just beyond that pass, kupo? Well, I have─enough to last me a lifetime, in fact. They're making it impossible to travel through Ohl Tahn unmolested. Could you get rid of four of them for me?
entries.fr: Aventuri, j'ai un service à vous demander, kuppo ! D'effrayants  rôdent dans les environs d'Ohl Tahn et me harcèlent. Si vous pouviez en éliminer ne serait-ce que quatre, je me sentirais plus rassuré, kuppo !
entries.ja:
冒険者さん、お願いがあるくぽ。
「」を4体ほど倒してくぽ。
この辺りをウロウロしてておっかないから、安心したいくぽ

entries.en: Every day, those vinegaroons walk back and forth...back and forth...flashing their blades and snarling. I've had just about enough of it, kupo! If you cut down four of them, it'll soon wipe the smiles off their faces!
entries.fr: S'il vous plaît, aventuri, éliminez quelques-uns de ces horribles  ! Quatre en moins, ce serait déjà un gros soulagement, kuppo !

entries.en: Thank you, adventurer! Now I can relax a little─but only a little, kupo. Those vinegaroons are always chasing after us moogles, snapping their bladed jaws and swinging their bladed tails. If I wasn't here to scare them away, this place would be a few pom-poms short of a picnic!
entries.fr: Vous leur avez réglé leur compte ? Merci, kuppo ! Ils me poursuivaient partout ! Je ne pouvais pas relâcher mon attention une seconde ! J'espère que leurs copains y réfléchiront à deux fois, maintenant !
entries.ja:
ありがとうくぽ！　これで安心して過ごせるくぽ！
モグを見つけると、いつまでも追いかけてくるから、
警戒してないといけなかったくぽ～。
